exposure: Responsibility system delivery mode plus position management with delivery ball
outcome: Duration of the whole delivery process
cohort: A total of 110 lying-in women from Maternal and Child Health care of Zaozhuang who voluntarily participated between January 2012 and December 2015.
finding: The responsibility system delivery mode plus position management with delivery ball significantly shortened the first and second stages of labor, reduced overall delivery process duration, decreased pain, lowered the cesarean section rate and postpartum bleeding, and increased maternal satisfaction.
mod_finding: The application of responsibility system delivery mode plus position management with delivery ball significantly lowered the cesarean section rate.
